message.content: Aisling expresses enthusiasm for using traps in battles, describing them as a "game changer." She mentions setting up ambushes that worked well and enjoys the added strategy they provide. This aligns with the general sentiment among the group, who appreciate the variety and depth that strategic elements bring to the gameplay. Specifically, Aisling recommends using traps as a method to enhance the tactical aspects of battles in "Octopath Traveler."
